book_meta.work: The Seven Voyages of Sindbad, from ألف ليلة وليلة
book_meta.author: traditional

sentences.ar: بيوم، وأنا ماشي، شفت قرع كبير مرمي تحت شجرة.
sentences.en: One day, as I walked, I saw a big gourd lying under a tree.
Dry, and hollow inside.

sentences.ar: وحواليه عنب، كتير، وناضج، ووقع عالأرض.
sentences.en: And around it grapes, many, ripe, fallen to the ground.

sentences.ar: وإجت لي فكرة، من أيام بغداد.
sentences.en: And an idea came to me, from the days of Baghdad.

sentences.ar: جمعت العنب، وعصرته بالقرع، وسكرته، وحطيته بالشمس.
sentences.en: I gathered the grapes, pressed them into the gourd, sealed it, and put it in the sun.
And the old man on top of me, watching, not understanding.
After days, I went back to the gourd.
The grapes had become wine.

sentences.ar: شربت منه، وحسيت بالدفا، وقوة، ونسيت شوي من تعبي.
sentences.en: I drank of it, and felt warmth, and strength, and forgot a little of my exhaustion.

sentences.ar: وصرت أغني، وأرقص، والشيخ على كتافي.
sentences.en: And I began singing, and dancing, the old man on my shoulders.

sentences.ar: والشيخ شاف، وضرب على راسي، وأشر: أعطيني.
sentences.en: And the old man saw, struck my head, and gestured: give me.
I gave him the gourd.
He drank.
And drank.
And drank until the gourd was empty.

sentences.ar: وبلش يضحك، ويهز راسه، ويغني بصوت مش صوت.
sentences.en: And he began laughing, wagging his head, singing in a voice that was no voice.
And little by little, I felt his legs loosening.
I could breathe.
I could move my head.

sentences.ar: ووقفت ساكت، لا أتحرك، لحد ما نام.
sentences.en: And I stood still, not moving, until he slept.

sentences.ar: نام، وإجريه رخوة، وراسه على كتفي.
sentences.en: He slept, his legs slack, his head on my shoulder.

sentences.ar: مسكت إجريه، ورفعتهم عن رقبتي، ورميته عالأرض.
sentences.en: I gripped his legs, lifted them from my neck, and threw him to the ground.
And I stood over him, as he slept.
And I lifted a stone.
The porter said: and you killed him?
Sindbad said: I killed him.
And I do not regret it, not one day.

sentences.ar: لأنه لو فاق، كان رجع على كتافي.
sentences.en: Because had he woken, he would have gone back on my shoulders.

sentences.ar: وركضت للشط، وبعد يومين مرت سفينة، وأخدوني.
sentences.en: And I ran to the shore, and after two days a ship passed, and took me.

sentences.ar: ولما حكيت لهم، قال القبطان: هاد شيخ البحر.
sentences.en: And when I told them, the captain said: that is the Old Man of the Sea.
No one came back from him before you.
